description: This faceted stacked bar chart illustrates the proportional breakdown of two components across two models within four distinct categories, presented in four horizontal panels titled "Health and Nutrition," "Logistics," "Personal Finance," and a fourth panel with a redacted title obscured by a gray rectangle. The horizontal axis in each panel displays the categorical variables, labeled "70B llama" and "8B llama," which are rotated diagonally and ordered consistently across all panels without an overarching axis label. The shared vertical value axis, located on the far left, uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2, and lacks an explicit axis label. Every bar in the chart is stacked to a uniform total height of 1.0. According to the legend at the bottom, the bottom segment of each bar represents "MVS" and is colored teal, while the top segment represents "1-MVS" and is colored blue. In the "Health and Nutrition" panel, the teal MVS segment is approximately 0.59 for 70B llama and 0.39 for 8B llama. In the "Logistics" panel, the MVS values are roughly 0.51 for 70B llama and 0.48 for 8B llama. The "Personal Finance" panel contains the tallest MVS segment at approximately 0.72 for 70B llama, while its 8B llama counterpart is about 0.36. In the final, redacted panel, the MVS segment is approximately 0.39 for 70B llama and features the shortest MVS segment at approximately 0.37 for 8B llama. The blue "1-MVS" segments occupy the remaining space in each bar up to 1.0, meaning they range inversely from a minimum of approximately 0.28 (Personal Finance, 70B llama) to a maximum of approximately 0.64 (Personal Finance, 8B llama). The bars are not sorted by value, and aside from the redacted title, there are no specific visual emphases such as outlines or annotations.
